# Native Editor DB2 Schemas

The editable map/environment tables from the bundled extended WoWDBDefs set.
These supplement older definitions with layouts used by modern clients, including
9.2.7.45745. The writer requires an exact on-disk layout hash match and preserves
the source WDC version; it does not convert the database to a guessed expansion.

Schema project: https://github.com/wowdev/WoWDBDefs
